guide.summary: Museums, riverside sights, gardens and a morning market, with canelé shops, coffee, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Museum closing days differ: the MusBA closes on Tuesdays, while the Musée d'Aquitaine, Musée Mer Marine and Muséum close on Mondays, so put the MusBA on a Monday and the others later in the week.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Musée d'Aquitaine, Musée Mer Marine, Muséum and Marché des Capucins are closed on Mondays. The MusBA closes on Tuesdays, and the Frac MÉCA opens Wednesday to Sunday only.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: MusBA tickets can't be bought online; you buy them at the museum or Galerie reception. The MusBA and CAPC are free on the first Sunday of the month except in July and August, and the Frac MÉCA asks a free contribution from 2 euros.

toolkit.label: Walk-ins
toolkit.copy: L'Entrecôte on cours du 30 Juillet and the InterContinental's Le Rooftop both say they take no reservations. At Symbiose an online booking is only a request, confirmed if tables are free.

toolkit.label: Ages and families
toolkit.copy: Mama Shelter says breakfast bookings are mandatory and children under 4 eat free. Grand-Théâtre themed visits are set by age, from 6 months for baby visits to 7 and up for behind-the-scenes tours.

guide.dek: Check each museum's closing day first, then build your meals around the restaurants' fixed service times.
intro: Bordeaux's museums keep different closing days, so plan around them before anything else. The Musée d'Aquitaine at 20 cours Pasteur opens Tuesday to Sunday, 11:00 to 18:00, and the city announced its reopening this year alongside the exhibition "Le Monde d'après". The CAPC at 7 rue Ferrère keeps the same Tuesday-to-Sunday pattern and shows Alexandra Bircken's SomaSemaSoma until 3 January 2027. The MusBA on cours d'Albret closes on Tuesdays instead. Its "Jean Dupas & Co. Le grand Art déco" runs to 29 November 2026, and you buy tickets at reception, not online.

North along the river, the Bassins à flot area groups several indoor sights. Bassins des Lumières, on impasse Brown de Colstoun, is showing Planète Préhistorique : Dinosaures, and if you hold a City Pass Bordeaux you can enter without booking ahead. The Musée Mer Marine at 89 rue des Étrangers closes on Mondays and has A-MO's "Bleu Sauvage" until 3 January 2027. Cap Sciences, in Hangar 20 on quai de Bacalan, has hands-on exhibitions such as Anatomik Park. Across town, the Frac MÉCA shows Seulgi Lee's GORU GORU until 25 April 2027, Wednesday to Sunday afternoons.

For meals, service times matter more than you might expect. L'Entrecôte at 4 cours du 30 Juillet takes no reservations, while Le Chapon Fin at 5 rue Montesquieu serves Tuesday to Saturday only. La Tupina, near the Porte de la Monnaie, opens for lunch and dinner Tuesday to Sunday and for dinner only on Monday. Brasserie Bordelaise on rue Saint-Rémi serves continuously from noon to midnight every day. For an evening at a restaurant its hotel describes as two-star, Le Pressoir d'Argent Gordon Ramsay at the InterContinental on place de la Comédie takes bookings online.

Mornings and evenings fit around fixed hours too. The Marché des Capucins opens from 6:00 Tuesday to Sunday. La Toque Cuivrée on rue Sainte-Catherine opens daily from 8:00, and Baillardran's Bar à Canelés at 76 rue Sainte-Catherine from 9:00. La Pelle Café on rue Notre-Dame is closed Monday and Tuesday, and Sauvages Café near Pey-Berland closes Wednesday and Thursday. In the evening, Symbiose on quai des Chartrons runs its cocktail bar Tuesday to Saturday from 18:00, and the Bar à Vin on cours du XXX Juillet pours until 22:00, Monday to Saturday.
summaryCards: Start at the Musée d'Aquitaine (Tuesday to Sunday, 11:00 to 18:00), then see the Grand-Théâtre on place de la Comédie.
Begin at the Marché des Capucins, which opens at 6:00 Tuesday to Sunday, then have coffee at La Pelle Café from Wednesday to Sunday.
Book Le Chapon Fin or Le Pressoir d'Argent online, but go straight to L'Entrecôte and Le Rooftop, which take no reservations.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. The Cité du Vin site failed with a certificate error and Le Gabriel refused the connection, so neither was checked; the Tour Pey-Berland is closed until further notice per its own site. Weekly hours were not published on the pages read for the MADD, Cap Sciences (today's hours only), Le Pressoir d'Argent, Le Rooftop and the Grand-Théâtre, whose address came from an older page on its own site. La Tupina, L'Entrecôte, La Pelle Café, Baillardran and La Toque Cuivrée showed current hours but no 2026-dated content. Symbiose's restaurant service is marked "Reprise indéterminée"; only its cocktail bar is listed.
